Daraxonrasib for Metastatic PDAC
headlines.summary: FDA approved once-daily oral daraxonrasib, marketed as Rasonque, for adults with metastatic pancreatic adenocarcinoma who have received at least one prior systemic therapy or who are not candidates for multiagent systemic therapy. The label creates the first FDA-approved broad RAS-targeted option in this high-mortality setting and does not require a companion diagnostic.
